_comment: P1 cross-fleet determinism job (scope 2026-05-23). Copy into gpu-jobs.local.json (or merge its 'jobs' array) and run `node scripts/gpu-job-queue.mjs` on each vast.ai fleet node. Each node writes its determinism manifest to DETERMINISM_OUT; collect the manifests from >=2 distinct machines into scripts/fleet-corpus-snapshot/ and feed them to assessDeterminismGate (see SemanticDeterminismGate.ts) for the promotion verdict. A determinism check needs CPU/BLAS reproducibility, not GPU — any node is a valid second machine.
